These JSON files were captured from the `tomigidt-observe-plan-act-v1`
implementation at commit `b33ab7a` (`feat: add persistent TOMIGIDt autonomous
single-agent loop`), before the incremental v2 policy was introduced. They are
actual old-policy outputs and frozen compatibility witnesses, not outputs
regenerated by the compatibility tests.

- `tomigidt_v1_default_session.json`: the default six-cycle mission, including
  discovery of the hazard at `00`, backtracking, and completion at `11`.
- `tomigidt_v1_deferred_session.json`: a static scenario with a one-expansion
  search budget, stopped after two independent DEFER decisions. Each decision
  reports one expansion because v1 restarts its search on each retry.
- `tomigidt_v1_waiting_agent.json`: a partial local sensor frame that produced
  WAIT. A later partial frame must not combine with these measurements to act.

The files retain the original manifest, decisions, packed forecasts, sensor
packets, and expected snapshot. New policy implementations must replay them
without changing their canonical contents or historical policy behavior.
Do not regenerate these files with v2 to make a compatibility test pass; correct
the reader or legacy-policy implementation instead.
